def factor_cycle_phase_duration_linearized(df):
    """Long-term trend strength with bounded phase duration, using EMA and ATR."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ema = df_copy["close"].ewm(span=120, adjust=False).mean()
    atr = talib.ATR(df_copy["high"].values, df_copy["low"].values, df_copy["close"].values, timeperiod=20)
    atr = pd.Series(atr, index=df_copy.index)
    distance = (df_copy["close"] - ema) / atr.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    direction = np.sign(distance)
    pos = direction > 0
    neg = direction < 0
    pos_cum = pos.cumsum()
    pos_reset = pos_cum.where(~pos).ffill().fillna(0.0)
    pos_streak = pos_cum - pos_reset
    neg_cum = neg.cumsum()
    neg_reset = neg_cum.where(~neg).ffill().fillna(0.0)
    neg_streak = neg_cum - neg_reset
    streak_raw = np.where(pos, pos_streak, -neg_streak)
    streak_compressed = np.tanh(np.abs(streak_raw) / 20.0)
    multiplier = 1.0 + 0.5 * streak_compressed
    factor = distance * multiplier
    factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    df_copy["factor_cycle_phase_duration_linearized"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_cycle_phase_duration_linearized"]
